text:
maria-sales: Quick ask from AcmeBank POC: they want confirmation on CMK options + delta in per-req latency and cost between using our key-proxy vs direct HSM for each request. Also need a timeline for rotation playbook. Can ops/crypto advise? cc @nate-se @olga-crypto :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: POC workspace acmebank-poc created (env id: poc-3142).

nate-se: What QPS and average token length are they planning? that'll change batching/caching recommendations.

maria-sales: They're targeting 120 rps peak, avg seq ~64 tokens. SLO: p95 <= 350ms. Also need an example SOW line item for HSM hours + rotation ops.

olga-crypto: We can support two patterns: 1) BYOK via cloud HSM (KMIP/cloud KMS) w/ per-request unwrap (higher latency) 2) Key-proxy (our managed ephemeral wrapping) with caching + rewrap to avoid per-token HSM calls. Proxy reduces HSM ops drastically. Latency delta: ~+25-40ms per-request with proxy, +80-140ms for direct HSM unwrap depending on network. For 120rps, proxy with a 1s cache works well.

nate-se: For 120rps + 64 tokens, batching into groups of 8 reduces per-token overhead. Recommend batch size 4-12, run perf test. We'll need a perf run on dedicated pool to produce numbers for SOW.

maria-sales: Can we quantify cost: HSM request pricing vs extra GPU tokens? customer expects an itemized estimate.

olga-crypto: Quick calc: at 120rps, 1s cache TTL => ~7,200 unwraps/hr. If HSM pricing $0.02/unwrap => $144/hr. With proxy, HSM ops drop to ~12 rewraps/hr (mostly rotation), negligible. We'll produce spreadsheet. Need customer's HSM rate.

legal-ops: Heads-up: for enterprise, they asked for rotation max window 7 days and audit logs retention 3 years. We can add clause but need SOC/attestation notes.

nate-se: I'll schedule a 90-min perf POC next Tue. Need access to their HSM test endpoint or we'll simulate with local KMIP server. Maria — can you confirm they can share ephemeral test creds?

maria-sales: Confirming with customer now. Also: can we offer a 'zero-downtime key rotation' doc?

olga-crypto: Yes. We have a runbook: dual-key rewrap + staged rollout. Snippet:
```
steps:
  1) deploy new KEKs
  2) run rewrap on cache nodes
  3) validate fingerprints & replicate
  4) decommission old KEK after TTL
```

maria-sales: Perfect. Anything blocking SOW approval?

nate-se: Blocker: need customer's test HSM latency numbers + approval for load testing window. Also need billing to approve temporary reserved capacity for perf run (estimate 4 GPU-hours).

finance: Finance ok to rubber-stamp up to $2k test spend if Sales signs off. Ping me once schedule set.

maria-sales: Thanks everyone. I'll get test creds and calendar invite. :thumbsup:
